name: house-model-v1
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: a portrait fashion photograph for the opening of the After Bells perfume-house story page. Portrait 2:3.
Create an original luxury fragrance editorial portrait of one fictional adult South Asian woman, about 30 years old, with warm medium-brown skin, strong natural features, dark expressive eyes and dark hair swept back in a loose, slightly imperfect low style. She wears a beautifully cut dark espresso wool blazer over a simple high-neck black top. The styling is understated and androgynous; no visible jewellery, logos or prints. Half-body portrait, natural upright posture, shoulders turned slightly away and face in a gentle three-quarter view looking just beyond the camera. Her expression is self-possessed and thoughtful, relaxed mouth, no exaggerated pout or smile. Hands are outside the crop.
Scene: a quiet architectural interior, a tactile warm-grey limestone reveal against a deep coffee-brown plaster wall, with soft evening light entering from the left. A broad diffused warm light catches her cheekbone and the tailoring; soft cool-neutral fill keeps real skin tones and shadow detail. Muted amber and espresso atmosphere, no orange colour cast. Subtle editorial film grain and natural tonal depth.
Composition: the model is centred, full head and hair completely visible within the middle 80% of the image. Hair begins around 13% down the frame, eyes around 29%, shoulders around 49%, waist near 88%. Generous negative space above the head and around the shoulders. The final photo will be shown whole in a 2:3 desktop frame, with a slightly shorter 4:5 phone crop, so keep the full head safely within both crops. The scene should feel intimate and human rather than a posed catalogue photo.
Real medium-format fashion photograph, 85mm portrait perspective, crisp eyes, fine individual hair strands, believable fabric weave and lapel construction, authentic skin pores and very subtle natural facial asymmetry. Restrained professional retouching, real photographic light and natural skin texture. This is an anonymous campaign model, not a founder, celebrity or historical person.
No perfume bottle, no product in hands, no labels, no flowers, no candles, no extravagant set dressing, no crown, no peacock, no gold dust or magical particles. No artificial skin smoothing, no waxy CGI look, no extreme gloss, no haze filter, no blur over the face. No text, logos, borders, watermarks or interface. One unified high-end editorial photograph.
